paragraphs: The F-Pace P250 has been part of the Jaguar SUV range since the model's launch in 2016. It uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine, part of Jaguar Land Rover's modular Ingenium family introduced in 2015. The P250 represents the highest-output 2.0-litre petrol variant in the F-Pace line-up, positioned between the discontinued P340 V6 and the P400 six-cylinder above it. It remains a current variant across the X761 generation.

cards.body: A 2.0L Petrol engine fitted to the F-Pace P250 — X761 (2016–present).
